excerpt: DMRadio-50L uses a 1 T average field toroidal magnet ... between 5 kHz and 5 MHz. DMRadio-m3 consists of a higher frequency LC-oscillator in a 4 T peak field solenoidal magnet ... between 30 MHz and 200 MHz. This experiment [50L] is being built on the Stanford University campus. This experiment [m3] is being built at SLAC National Lab.
title: Status of DMRadio-50L and DMRadio-m3
